name: cloudtube
description: Browse and read Google Drive, and publish a stored video to YouTube, entirely from chat.
long_description:
Connects Claude to a Google Drive account and a YouTube channel.

Browse folders, search by name, type or date, read documents (including Google Docs, Sheets, Slides and PDFs), and upload a video from Drive to YouTube with a title, description, tags and privacy status supplied in conversation.

Authorisation happens through Google's own consent screen: the extension returns a link, you approve it in a browser, and only a scoped, revocable token is ever stored. Drive access is read-only, so the server cannot modify or delete your files.

Uploads run as background jobs whose progress survives a restart, and every failure returns a specific reason with guidance on whether retrying can help.

python_path.title: Python interpreter (optional)
python_path.description: Leave as 'python' if the Python on your PATH already has this project's dependencies installed. If you used the project's setup script, point this at its virtual environment instead: <project>/.venv/Scripts/python.exe on Windows, or <project>/.venv/bin/python on macOS and Linux.

client_secret_path.title: Google OAuth client secrets file (optional)
client_secret_path.description: Leave blank if you saved client_secret.json into the server's state folder (it will tell you the exact path if it cannot find one). Otherwise pick the file you downloaded from Google Cloud Console for a Desktop OAuth client. You need your own: this extension ships no credentials, because a Google Cloud project's quota and test-user list are per-account. See docs/SETUP_GOOGLE_CLOUD.md. The file stays on your machine and is sent nowhere except Google.
